objective: Implement the accepted single-bed ward-to-community boundary model with explicit physical vacancy, transfer handover, origin-claim release and downstream-to-upstream ED boarding feedback.
steps: Implement a deterministic pure model with typed inputs, statuses and errors, checked tick arithmetic, and separate actual departure, physical bed vacancy, community arrival, handover completion, origin-claim release and ED admission.
Keep the ward bed claim held from before departure until explicit modeled handover; count ED boarding until that claim release and admit at max(ED-ready, handover tick).

Add focused deterministic positive and negative tests for every ADR-0013 oracle, including community and pickup delay, in-transit censoring, arrival with handover pending, inclusive horizon, zero duration, invalid times and overflow.
Preserve A4.2 TransferManager semantics, clinical compatibility, default profile schema, dependencies and Kairos sources/pin.

verification.oracle: Ward/community boundary cases pass deterministically and the A4.2 transfer contract remains compatible.
All careops-core targets pass Clippy with warnings denied.

acceptance: Identical input always produces identical outcome; readiness beyond horizon and checked tick overflow fail closed.
Actual ward departure requires readiness, community place and pickup; physical occupancy ends at departure, but origin claim remains held through arrival and explicit handover.
ED admission waits until handover releases the origin claim; downstream delay increases ED boarding without freeing the claimed bed early.
Inclusive-horizon departure, missing or late place/pickup, in-transit horizon, arrival-at-horizon with pending handover, and handover complete at the inclusive horizon are distinguishable.
Ward occupancy and origin-claim durations are explicitly measured from clinical readiness; the fixture does not assert total durations from unstated start times.
No clinical policies, site defaults, full capacity allocator, new dependencies, ED schema changes or Kairos changes are introduced.
stop_conditions: The model cannot represent physical vacancy and claim retention separately
An oracle requires site-specific clinical policy or full multi-bed allocation
Any out-of-scope ED, Kairos, dependency, profile or current-state edit is needed
